name: Cabbage sabzi (cabbage stir-fried with potato and peas)

source.name: Hebbar's Kitchen (hebbarskitchen.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 4. North Indian style with potato and peas, as in the cited recipe. Weights: 3 tsp oil = 13.6 g, 1 tsp cumin = 2.1 g, 1 tsp kasuri methi = 0.6 g (as fenugreek seed), 1 onion = 110 g, 1/2 tsp ginger garlic paste split 1.25 g each, 1 tomato = 120 g, 1 potato = 150 g (raw, peeled), 4 cups shredded cabbage = 280 g (70 g/cup), 1/2 cup peas = 72 g (raw), coriander powder 1 tsp = 1.8 g (as coriander seed), garam masala as curry powder, coriander leaves 2 tbsp = 2 g. No water added; assumed ~20% of the weight lost as steam (dry stir-fry). A katori or bowl is taken as 1 cup, as everywhere in the catalog.
